question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the bracketed word in the given sentence.

It is irrelevance, at least to me, whether the grant was (improvident) or not.
solution:
The correct answer is **'thrifty'. (**मितव्ययी) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Improvident: **(अविवेकी, बेपरवाह) Lacking foresight or the ability to plan for the future, spendthrift or thoughtless.

 
 
• **Example: **His ***improvident ***spending habits left him in debt.
 
 
 
• **Thrifty: **(मितव्ययी) Showing care and wisdom in managing resources, especially money; economical.
 
 
• **Example: **He is quite ***thrifty ***and saves a significant portion of his income.
 
 

*Therefore, the correct answer is **'**Thrifty'.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Tardy:** (विलंब) Habitually late or delayed; not punctual.

 
 
• **Example: **The headmaster noticed that the same students were often ***tardy ***to class.
 
 
 
• **Cautious: **(सतर्क) Exercising care and prudence to avoid potential risks or dangers.
 
 
• **Example: **Everybody should be ***cautious ***while driving.
 
 
 
• **Hungry:** (भूखा) Experiencing a desire for food due to an empty stomach; a feeling of appetite.
 
 
• **Example: **After a long hike, they were all very ***hungry ***and eagerly ate their meals.
